F1.summary: Atomic Candidate Build & Rollback Isolation: Candidate index builds on an isolated instance; durable state is saved only after candidate build succeeds; atomic pointer swap guarantees rejected candidates never leak into active index.

F2.summary: Contract Scene Timestamp Semantics & Browser Automation: In dippie.catalog.v1, scenes.start_ms is directly in file timeline (seek to scene.start_ms / 1000 without adding coverage offset). Real browser automation via Chrome CDP verifies decoded frames, pause/resume, 15.0s scene seek, 3 sequential seeks, episode 2 switch with grant token, and protected scene seek.

F3.summary: Single Source of Accepted State on Recovery: FastAPI lifespan checks if accepted state was recovered before attempting to load default catalog snapshot; default catalog only loads when no accepted state exists.

F4.summary: Hermetic Production-Stack Rehearsal Identity & Isolation: Live services on isolated ports (8008, 8088, 3008, 9228); grant strictly bound and rejected on second real protected asset (asset_feature_03); double restart verification; processes terminated strictly by PID.
